verdict.rationale: Docs mention that Jev is not trained on customer data and offer zero data retention (ZDR) for enterprise customers, pointing to a DPA/Privacy Policy, but there is no documented self-service deletion mechanism, no API/dashboard control for retention settings on standard accounts, and ZDR is explicitly gated to enterprise plans only. Missing for 10: user-facing deletion API/UI, retention controls for non-enterprise tiers, independent verification of these privacy claims.
